critical_code_review_comments: routes_exams.py (~410 LOC) is well-structured: _sections_for() correctly returns None for admins vs the teacher's assigned section set, which _exam_out uses to filter sheets/sections — teachers only see what they can act on.

POST /exams validates end>=start, unique subjects, section/subject existence, pass<=max (via ExamSubject.model_validator), and subject date within exam window; returns normalized output with sheets/sections/progress.

PUT /exams/{eid}/marks enforces: exam.status==marks_open (locked after publish), only in-section students, no duplicates, everyone-required (set(ids)==valid), 0<=marks<=max, half-mark only (round(m*2)==m*2), and routes through _can_assign (homework helper) so teachers can't touch subjects they don't teach — matches the pytest invariants.

POST /exams/{eid}/status?status=published computes missing sheets via _exam_out and returns a human message listing up to 5 missing; publishing is strictly blocked until all section×subject sheets are entered. Reopen clears published_at.

compute_results() computes per-student totals/percentages, ranks (dense: 1 + count of strictly-higher percentages), and class_average over students with any entered marks; Grade uses the CBSE scale (A1 91 … E <33). Absent students count as Fail with marks=null (consistent with pytest absent_row assertion).

GET /parent/children/{student_id}/exams filters status='published' and section_ids contains child's section_id, then uses _parent_links to confirm guardianship — correctly 403s strangers and hides unpublished exams.

GET /exams/{eid}/report-card/{student_id}.pdf uses optional_user (accepts Authorization header or ?token=) → 401 if missing; staff gated by _section_access; parent gated by publish state + verified guardianship. Response is private, no-store, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff — safe for browser inline open.
_render_pdf is defensive: broken logo is swallowed (noqa BLE001) and never blocks the report card; A4 layout uses school brand primary/secondary colours; grade legend printed under the summary.
Frontend exams/[id].tsx surfaces backend validation verbatim via useToast(error) — publish-missing and marks range errors reach the user in the mutation onError path (api.ts throws Error(detail)).

Frontend exams/marks.tsx uses an edits overlay over server data and only lets save when text is a digit/decimal (regex /[^0-9.]/g in onChangeText) — a client-side guard matching the backend half-mark rule.

ReportCardButton builds reportCardUrl(examId, studentId) and opens it via WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync — matches the backend's token= query support so parents get an inline PDF without an auth-header round-trip.
